data.name: Hikmat
data.gender_notes: Hikmat is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Hikmat is an Arabic name for both boys and girls, which means wisdom. It is derived from the word 'hikmah' which signifies the quality of being wise or knowledgeable. The name is mentioned in the Quran, and it is highly regarded in Islamic culture. The name Hikmat carries the meaning “Wisdom” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in English, Urdu, Hindi. Parents who choose Hikmat usually hope their child will grow to embody wisdom and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A name that signifies wisdom and knowledge, encouraging the pursuit of enlightenment and spiritual growth.
data.etymology: Hikmat belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Wisdom.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Hikmat total 8, giving a life-path number of 8. Number 8 is linked with Saturn and with the qualities of ambition, resilience and material success.

in_arabic.name: حكمة
in_arabic.meaning: الحكمة هي الحكمة الالهية او الحكمة من الله
in_arabic.long_meaning: الحكمة هي اسم مشتق من الحكمة الالهية، وتعني الحكمة من الله، والفهم العميق للدين والقدرة على اتخاذ القرارات الصائبة. وردت الحكمة في القرآن الكريم في عدة مواضع، منها قوله تعالى: 'وَمَن يُؤتَ الحِكمَةَ فَقَد أُعطيَ خَيرًا كَثيرًا' (البقرة: 269). تعتبر الحكمة من الأسماء التي تحمل معاني روحانية ودلالات عميقة في الثقافة الإسلامية.

in_urdu.name: حکمت
in_urdu.meaning: حکمت کا مطلب ہے الہی حکمت یا اللہ کی طرف سے حکمت
in_urdu.long_meaning: حکمت ایک ایسا نام ہے جو الہی حکمت سے ماخوذ ہے، اور اس کا مطلب ہے اللہ کی طرف سے حکمت یا الہی رہنمائی۔ عربی جڑوں سے ماخوذ، 'حکمت' قرآن کریم میں بھی ذکر کی گئی ہے، جیسے کہ سورہ بقرہ میں: 'وَمَن يُؤتَ الحِكمَةَ فَقَد أُعطيَ خَيرًا كَثيرًا' (البقرة: 269)। یہ نام اسلامی تقالید میں گہری دلالتوں اور روحانی معانیを持つ माना جاتا ہے، خاص طور پر جنوبی ایشیائی مسلم معاشروں میں جہاں اردو زبان بولی جاتی ہے۔

in_hindi.name: हिकमत
in_hindi.meaning: हिकमत का अर्थ है ईश्वरीय ज्ञान या अल्लाह की ओर से ज्ञान
in_hindi.long_meaning: हिकमत एक ऐसा नाम है जो ईश्वरीय ज्ञान से लिया गया है, और इसका अर्थ है अल्लाह की ओर से ज्ञान या ईश्वरीय मार्गदर्शन। यह नाम अरबी मूल से आया है और इसका उल्लेख कुरआन में भी किया गया है, जैसे कि सूरह बकरा में: 'وَمَن يُؤتَ الحِكمَةَ فَقَد أُعطيَ خَيرًا كَثيرًا' (البقرة: 269)। यह नाम भारतीय मुस्लिम समुदाय में गहरी आध्यात्मिक महत्ता और पारंपरिक महत्व रखता है।

in_pashto.name: حکمت
in_pashto.meaning: حکمت د الهي حکمت یا د الله له خوا حکمت معنی لري
in_pashto.long_meaning: حکمت داسې نوم دی چی د الهي حکمت څخه اخیستل شوی دی، او د الله له خوا حکمت یا الهي لارښوونې ته اشاره کوي. دا نوم عربي ريښو څخه راغلی دی او په قرآن کریم کې يې ذکر شوی دی، لکه څنګه چې د بقرہ سورې کې: 'وَمَن يُؤتَ الحِكمَةَ فَقَد أُعطيَ خَيرًا كَثيرًا' (البقرة: 269). دا نوم په افغان او پښتني دودیزو کړاوونو کې د روحاني معنا او کلتوري اهميت څخه برخمن دی.

in_english.name: Hikmat
in_english.meaning: Divine wisdom, understanding, or insight given by Allah
in_english.long_meaning: Hikmat is a name derived from Arabic, meaning divine wisdom, understanding, or insight given by Allah. The term 'hikmat' appears in the Quran (e.g., Al-Baqarah: 269), signifying profound knowledge and the ability to make wise decisions. In Islamic tradition, 'Hikmat' is associated with spiritual maturity and the acquisition of knowledge that guides individuals towards righteousness. The name reflects a deep connection to Islamic values and is widely appreciated across various Muslim cultures for its meaningful connotation.

data.cultural_impact: The name Hikmat holds deep cultural significance in Islamic societies. It is considered to be a noble and respectable name for children, reflecting the desire of parents to instill the value of wisdom and knowledge within their children. The name signifies the importance of education, intellectual growth, and critical thinking skills. Hikmat is also associated with intellectuals, scholars, and philosophers, and is seen as a desirable trait among peers and society.
data.spiritual_significance: In Islamic tradition, Hikmat holds a profound spiritual significance. It reflects the human pursuit of knowledge and understanding of the world around us, and the recognition that wisdom is a valuable gift from Allah. The name reminds us of the importance of seeking knowledge and wisdom in all aspects of life, and of striving to live a wise and virtuous life. In the Quran, Allah says, "And remember when Abraham said, 'My Lord, show me how You grant me [widespread] authority and grant me [great] knowledge.'" (2:286). The name Hikmat serves as a reminder of the importance of this pursuit and the blessings that come from seeking wisdom and knowledge.
